response.justification: The candidate is a versatile senior full-stack engineer with nearly 20 years of experience, strong testing culture, and some high-scale systems exposure, but the resume shows no evidence of experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flagging, or growth measurement work — the core of this role. His experience also reads as senior/staff-level breadth-oriented IC work rather than principal-level, multi-workstream architectural leadership at enterprise scale.
strengths: 20 years of broad engineering experience across web, backend, mobile, and embedded systems
High-throughput distributed systems exposure (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, open-source authorship, and community teaching
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-measurement experience anywhere in the resume
No demonstrated principal-level scope: no evidence of leading multi-team initiatives or org-wide platform architecture
Limited telemetry/metrics infrastructure and statistical analysis experience relative to role requirements

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering fundamentals and scale exposure
